Details
This listing includes three vintage pen sets from well-known manufacturers. The first is a Cross gold tone ballpoint pen in its original branded case, featuring the Cross logo and detailed clip with minimal wear. The second set is a Sheaffer pen set in a brown and cream case, containing a black fountain pen with a 14K gold nib and matching black ballpoint pen, both with gold accents and personalized engravings. The third item is a Sheaffer silver tone ballpoint pen in its original box, with the Sheaffer brand engraved on the barrel. All pens show gentle signs of use consistent with vintage writing instruments and are suitable for collectors.

The interior is stamped “14K” with an additional maker’s mark. Gold purity has not been independently verified, and the stones’ identities and natural or synthetic origin have not been established.
Approximate U.S. ring size: 7.5. Total weight, including stones: 3.54 grams.
Pre-owned condition with visible scratches and wear to the mounting, along with surface wear to the stones. Please review all photos for design, markings, and condition details.

A charming collection of Nintendo-themed toy figures featuring Mario, Luigi, and Peach, each designed with a blocky, stylized aesthetic reminiscent of classic video game characters. These figures are shown both assembled in their green pipe bases and as individual pieces, highlighting their modular design and collectible appeal. The set includes two small enemy blocks and a question mark block, adding to the interactive play value. The figures are in excellent condition with vibrant colors and clear character details.
